description: This file declares interfaces, constants, types, and includes necessary headers for a CWMP (CPE WAN Management Protocol) plugin component, likely used for managing device configurations and interactions within a TR-069 management framework.

classes.name: cwmp_plugin_app_t
classes.description: Structure holding application context including device management handle, parser, and initialization status.

classes.name: cwmp_proc_ctx_t
classes.description: Structure representing the context of a CWMP process, including control process pointer, callbacks, and private data.

methods.name: _cwmp_plugin_main
methods.description: Main entry point for processing plugin reasons, initializing or managing the plugin's core functions.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_set_app
methods.description: Sets the application context with device management and parser.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_get_dm
methods.description: Returns the device management handle.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_get_parser
methods.description: Returns the parser used by the plugin.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_get_config
methods.description: Returns the configuration variables for the plugin.

methods.name: start_cwmpd
methods.description: Starts the CWMP daemon/process.

methods.name: stop_cwmpd
methods.description: Stops the CWMP daemon/process.

methods.name: isAddressIpV6
methods.description: Checks if the provided address is an IPv6 address.

methods.name: proc_finished_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when a process is finished, handling event data.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_netmodel_open_queries
methods.description: Opens network model queries on the specified interface path.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_netmodel_close_queries
methods.description: Closes network model queries.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_netmodel_init
methods.description: Initializes network model components.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_netmodel_find_ip
methods.description: Finds the IP addresses related to network interfaces.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_netmodel_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up network model resources.

methods.name: open_cwmpd_listening_port
methods.description: Opens the port for CWMP communication.

methods.name: close_cwmpd_listening_port
methods.description: Closes the CWMP listening port.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_update_conreq_host
methods.description: Updates the connection request host address.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_update_conreq_port
methods.description: Updates the connection request port.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_transfer_init
methods.description: Initializes transfer-related resources.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_transfer_clean
methods.description: Cleans up transfer resources.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_manageabledevice_init
methods.description: Initializes manageable device components.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_manageabledevice_clean
methods.description: Cleans up manageable device components.

methods.name: cwmp_proc_ctx_new
methods.description: Creates a new CWMP process context.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_getFaultString
methods.description: Returns a string description for a given fault code.

methods.name: get_bus_ctx
methods.description: Retrieves the bus context for a given input path.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_add_subscription
methods.description: Adds a subscription with a specified path and filter.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_del_subscription
methods.description: Removes a subscription with specified path and callback.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_xmpp_init
methods.description: Initializes XMPP communication.

methods.name: _connreq_xmpp_connection_changed
methods.description: Handles changes in XMPP connection status.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_dm_save
methods.description: Saves the device management state.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_init_done
methods.description: Checks if plugin initialization is complete.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_cwmpd_start_avoided
methods.description: Determines if starting CWMP daemon is avoided.
